entities.summary: Bingöl, known as Çapakçur before 1944, is a city in Turkey. It is the seat of Bingöl Province and Bingöl District, and has a population of 133,423 (2022). The city is situated in a predominantly Kurdish-speaking region of eastern Turkey and is known in Kurdish as Çewlik; it has been the subject of scholarly attention as a site of Kird/Zaza and Kurmanji Kurdish identity formation. Bingöl is a city in West Asia. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 81 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
